mandatoryCriteria: C1: Readonly selectable copyable sample in Settings Connections with required title and unambiguous accessible project/board/column, exact priority/date/default and manual assignment guidance.
C2: No automatic send, storage or backend schema/tool/authority change; timeout retries preserve operation ID and unchanged input; hosted supported-client limit explicitly Claude.
C3: Accessible keyboard disclosure, labelled textarea, polite clipboard success and selected manual fallback, 320px layout with no horizontal overflow.
C4: Production IMAGE_VERIFIER matches UAT; prod and UAT origins, Hyperdrive and private R2 remain distinct with no test flags or unsafe staging expiration.

C5: Independent affected web test/type/build/browser checks pass on frozen source; unchanged backend source/tool/schema/migration continuity preserved from historical exact review, not relabelled freshly tested.
scopeAndExclusions: Scoped source delta approval before candidate CI, migration and deployment operations. Acceptance inherited from preimplementation PLAN.md; JSON is an exact restatement, not new relaxed criteria. Local synthetic component browser/clipboard, existing web suite, build/type. Historical backend review provenance must remain byte-identical except declared changed UI/config. No fresh PostgreSQL/API/full98check, hosted provider, cloud writes, live sign-in or production proof claimed. Sanitized build command refinement requested by Architect before scoring: whitelist HOME/PATH/TMPDIR/LANG plus fixed production/export; root/apps/web dotenv and devvars filenames absent. Earlier inherited-environment successful build retained as historical auxiliary evidence.
